728-856-5776-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

240-574-5470-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-5470-6968.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

1687-4247-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1687-4247-5972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-5686-6012--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1373-1479-2515-2653-7846.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1373-1479-2515-2653-7846.description:
Play Survivors' Encampment.
When Survivors' Encampment enters, Kodama, Hazezon and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing not to put anything onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Hazezon trigger, creating two 2/2 Sand Warrior creature tokens.
When the Sand Warriors enter, Kodama triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Survivors' Encampment's second ability by tapping it and a Sand Warrior, adding {R}.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning Survivors' Encampment from the battlefield to your hand, giving a creature trample until end of turn.
Resolve the first Kodama trigger, choosing not to put anything onto the battlefield.
Resolve the second Kodama trigger, putting Survivors' Encampment from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Survivors' Encampment enters,  Hazezon and Nissa trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2438-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
2438-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

372-3306-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3306-7487.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

891-1052-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

2440-4758-6737-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Barret triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2440-4758-6737-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3228-5477-7296.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

1069-1256-5499-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-5499-7296.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2866-3689-6518-7183.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

522-997-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Melira.
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1496-2577-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1496-2577-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

141-2034-3645.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

435-1304-4679.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature, artifact, or land that can produce at least {2}.
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
435-1304-4679.description:
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Nature's Chosen attached to Yenna, untapping Yenna, and scrying 2.
Activate the Nature's Chosen token's second ability by tapping Yenna, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate the Nature's Chosen token's first ability by paying {0}, untapping Yenna.
Activate Auratog by sacrificing the Nature's Chosen token, causing Auratog to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
If the mana-producing permanent can produce at least {3}, this combo produces infinite mana that artifacts, creatures, and lands you control can produce.

3263-3784-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Vhal.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
3263-3784-4222.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {3} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Murderous Redcap

1657-2034-3908.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Spark Double, adding {C}{C}.
When Spark Double dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
As Spark Double enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Murderous Redcap with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

643-1099-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-1099-4302.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing a creature, which is a Goblin due to Maskwood Nexus.
The creature dies as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, triggering Bishop of Wings' second ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, triggering Bishop of Wings' first ability, causing you to gain four life.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve all Sling-Gang Lieutenant abilities, causing any number of target player(s) to lose infinite life and you to gain infinite life.

2323-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2323-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
The creature dies, triggering Body Dropper, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
